title: Fleet detailing: why scheduled service beats one-offs
description: How scheduled on-site detailing helps Calgary companies keep work trucks, company vehicles and equipment presentable, protected and ready for resale.
excerpt: Clean trucks represent the company on every job site. Here's how scheduled, on-site fleet care works and what it protects beyond appearance.

sections.heading: Your trucks are a moving billboard
paragraphs: Customers judge a contractor by the truck that pulls into their driveway. A clean, maintained fleet says the work will be done the same way. A filthy one says the opposite, whether it's fair or not.

sections.heading: Protection, not just appearance
paragraphs: Salt and mag chloride left on a truck through winter attacks paint, wheels and undercarriage components. Interiors that never get cleaned wear out faster, with grit grinding into seats and carpets. Both show up at trade-in time.

sections.heading: Why on-site matters for fleets
paragraphs: Every hour a truck spends driving to a shop and waiting is an hour it isn't working. Our vans carry their own water and power, so we detail vehicles in your yard or shop bay, on a schedule set around your crews.

sections.heading: How a fleet program is set up
paragraphs: We start with a walk of the fleet, agree on a service level per vehicle type, and set a recurring schedule. You get one invoice and one contact, and vehicles that need extra attention get flagged instead of quietly getting worse.
